PREFIX  rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX  wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

  { ?var1  rdf:type  wikibase:Property }
positive_queries:
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX  url:  <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT  ?var1
WHERE
  { ?var1  rdf:type  wikibase:Property
    OPTIONAL
      { ?var1  url:description  ?var2
        FILTER ( lang(?var2) = "ml" )
      }
    FILTER ( ! bound(?var2) )
  }
ORDER BY ASC(?var2)

SELECT  ?var1 ?var2
WHERE
  {   { SELECT  ("Avec" AS ?var1) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?var3) AS ?var2)

          { <http://www.bigdata.com/queryHints#Query>
                      <http://www.bigdata.com/queryHints#optimizer>  "None" .

            ?var3  wdt:P625  ?var4

    UNION
      { SELECT  ("Sans" AS ?var1) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?var3) AS ?var2)
        WHERE
          { <http://www.bigdata.com/queryHints#Query>

            ?var3 (wdt:P131)+ wde:Q12717 .
            ?var3 wdt:P31/(wdt:P279)* wde:Q16970

              { ?var3  wdt:P625  _:b0 }

PREFIX  wde:  <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?var1 (COUNT(DISTINCT ?var2) AS ?var3) ?var4
WHERE
  { BIND(if(EXISTS { ?var2  wdt:P50  wde:Q46225794 }, "string1", "string2") AS ?var4)
    BIND(str(year(?var5)) AS ?var1)
    ?var6  wdt:P50    wde:Q46225794 .
    ?var2  wdt:P2860  ?var6 ;
           wdt:P577   ?var5
  }
GROUP BY ?var1 ?var4
ORDER BY DESC(?var1)

PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  wde:  <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?var1 ?var2 ?var3 ?var4
WHERE
  { ?var1  wdt:P27  wde:Q142
    { ?var1  wdt:P27  wde:Q34266 }
    ?var1  wdt:P106  ?var2 .
    ?var2 (wdt:P279)* wde:Q901
    OPTIONAL
      { ?var1  rdfs:label  ?var3
        FILTER ( lang(?var3) = "fr" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?var1  wdt:P18  ?var4 }
  }
